_instructions: Players see this file in the launcher. Add each player-visible change here in the same commit: launcher changes to beta.launcher, game changes Beta now builds to beta.game. Releases move beta into a new entry (npm run update:game does it). One plain sentence for players per line, no commit hashes or PR numbers. See AGENTS.md.

launcher: If you already have HD textures, the launcher downloads the new HD texture extras on their own (about 65 MB) instead of the whole pack, and again whenever a newer set comes out.
Show on Discord: while you play, your Discord profile shows where you are in the game, your Shine count and how long you've played. Turn it off under Manage game.
The launcher keeps its size on Windows displays with high scaling.
A changelog: see what changed in the launcher and the game with the new button beside Settings. It opens by itself once after an update.
"Skip intro movies" is now "Skip cutscenes", since it skips every movie.

changes: HD textures cover 208 more textures the UHD pack lacked, including the Pianta and balloon counters, the pause screen's maps, menus and Peach.
Heavy scenes like Delfino Plaza run much smoother: the game takes less than half as long on each frame.
Wiggler's music speeds up when you hit him and powers down when he's defeated, as on the GameCube.
Petey Piranha, Mecha Bowser and other bosses animate at their original speed at 60 and 120 fps.
The episode select screen shows its coloured background again instead of black.
Fixed dark fog bands and shimmering HD textures under the sea in Noki Bay.
Fixed Shadow Mario never taking Peach in Super Mario Eclipse's Delfino Plaza.
Portal movies keep playing when Skip cutscenes is on.
The game reports what you're doing for Discord.
Super Mario Eclipse downloads from SMS Launcher's own mirror, with GameBanana as the fallback.
Fixed Super Mario Eclipse crashing when you enter Bianco Hills or Erto Rock.
Fixed the camera staying tilted in Super Mario Eclipse after Delfino Plaza's opening cutscene plays to the end.

launcher: HDR settings for Windows: calibration, paper white, peak brightness, contrast, saturation and highlights.
FSR 1 and NIS upscaling under Settings → Picture → Scaling, with a quality choice.
The top bar shows how many players are online. Turn off anonymous usage sharing any time under Manage game.

changes: HDR output on Windows, and on more graphics cards.
NIS (NVIDIA Image Scaling) joins FSR 1 as an upscaler.
Fixed the Eclipse crashes at every stage exit and in the Tutorial on Windows.
Fixed Puffer self-collisions when firing at Petey at high frame rates.
Held sound effects, like the Rocket nozzle charge, keep playing at 60 fps.
Button prompt glyphs draw correctly with the system font.

launcher: Graphics presets: Low, Medium, High, Ultra and Steam Deck.
Button prompts: Original, Xbox, PlayStation 5, Steam Deck, keyboard, or Automatic.
A game source row with only a branch, tag or commit now uses our fork.

changes: Button prompts for Xbox, PlayStation, Steam Deck and keyboard.
Smoother heavy scenes: less time spent in the vertex loader and thread switches.
A full crash report is written on every platform.
Fixed the Turbo nozzle writing past its own memory.

launcher: Controller button remapping on the Controls page, plus Soft L and Soft R bindings.
The activity log now docks inside the launcher, and Copy log copies the full run.
A check-for-updates button next to the launcher update status.
A Heat-wave effect switch under Settings → Picture.
A note for SteamOS and Steam Deck players about Steam Input.

changes: 60 and 120 fps gameplay stays at full speed when the display makes the game wait.
GameCube controller adapters are supported.
Controller buttons can be remapped.
Native crashes now log their code and location.
Fixed Mario's flags in Super Mario Eclipse.
Fixed the Gelato gatekeeper's goop angles.
Linux builds use the system graphics driver's own libraries.
The performance overlay costs less to draw.
